evidence: Reviewed frozen design.md Goals and boundaries and Proposed behavior against the maintainer journey.
Reviewed spec.md FR-001, FR-003, FR-005, FR-007, FR-011, and FR-012 for invocation, discovery, relevance, shared backlog, prioritization, and reporting.
Reviewed spec.md User Stories 1–3, including priorities, independent tests, and acceptance scenarios.
spec.md, FR-011: "The system MUST assign each issue a priority using documented criteria and distinguish the rationale when the ranking is not obvious."
spec.md, FR-012: "it MUST distinguish full coverage, partial coverage, and failed runs."
spec.md, User Story 1 / Acceptance Scenario 1: "the auditor examines the entire session, including earlier context, for relevant skill friction."
spec.md, User Story 1: "A maintainer manually invokes f-auditor to find user-visible functional problems with the two skills across projects under their GitRepo folder."
spec.md, User Story 2: "The auditor updates it without undoing human status changes or losing edits."
spec.md, User Story 3 / Acceptance Scenario 2: "it returns an actionable, distinguishable outcome instead of claiming full success."
Reviewed frozen design.md Builder choices to resolve in planning; did not treat the deferred exact priority rubric or file representation as independently settled implementation requirements.
Reviewed spec.md Acceptance Scenarios and SC-001 through SC-007 for observable requirement coverage.
Reviewed spec.md FR-002, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, FR-008, FR-010, FR-011, and FR-018.
spec.md, FR-002: "The default audit window MUST be the 24 hours immediately preceding a single captured audit-start instant, expressed unambiguously in time."
spec.md, FR-004: "The system MUST limit eligible sessions to those reliably associated with the configured repository/folder root"
spec.md, FR-008: "The system MUST consolidate occurrences of the same underlying problem across sessions under one issue and retain the evidence for each occurrence."
spec.md, FR-010: "pre-fix evidence alone MUST NOT trigger a regression."
spec.md, FR-018: "The system MUST NOT modify the audited skills, mark issues fixed, create external issues, commit, push, or deploy as part of an audit."
spec.md, SC-002: "Every reported fixture finding contains an affected skill, actionable proposed improvement, priority, `Not Fixed` initial status, and traceable session evidence."
FR-001 requires a documented manual command and prerequisites; FR-016 assigns contextual analysis to an agent skill and discovery and safe updates to a local helper.
FR-003 and FR-019 define whole-session selection and require uncertainty about closure, workspace, completeness, or activity time to be surfaced.

Frozen design.md, Builder choices to resolve in planning, explicitly delegates executable packaging, source adapters, closure evidence, identifiers, and model/runtime selection. No unsupported host API assumptions or additional interface blockers were identified.
Reviewed frozen refinery-state.md D-009 and Q-009; retained the approved skill-plus-helper architecture.
Reviewed spec.md FR-001, FR-003, FR-016, FR-017, and FR-019 for manual entry, history discovery, agent/helper separation, non-interactive operation, and uncertain metadata.
Reviewed spec.md User Story 3 and frozen design.md Approaches considered and Builder choices to resolve in planning.

Edge Cases explicitly covers interrupted runs, changing or partially read sources, overlapping windows, and uncertain session metadata; locking or optimistic concurrency is explicitly delegated to planning.

FR-009 requires preservation of human edits and detection or prevention of concurrent-update conflicts; User Story 2, Scenario 4 permits retaining the edit or reporting a conflict without overwriting it.
FR-012, FR-014, and FR-019 require distinguishable incomplete or failed outcomes and preservation of the existing backlog before a safe update.
Reviewed spec.md Edge Cases covering changing or inaccessible histories, interruptions, concurrent edits, repeat windows, and insufficient regression evidence.
Reviewed spec.md FR-003, FR-009, FR-012, FR-014, FR-015, and FR-019.
Reviewed spec.md User Story 2 Acceptance Scenarios 2–4 and SC-003 through SC-005.
FR-004 requires reliable association with a configurable root; Edge Cases excludes similarly prefixed outside-root paths and uncertain metadata from assumed eligibility.
FR-013 prohibits secret disclosure in the shared file, console, and intermediate artifacts, and requires treating transcripts as data rather than instructions.

FR-018 prohibits modification of audited skills, completion marking, external issue creation, commits, pushes, and deployment; SC-007 requires representative secret and instruction-like transcript tests.
Reviewed spec.md Edge Cases concerning similarly prefixed outside-root paths, credentials, secrets, and instructions directed at the auditor.
Reviewed spec.md FR-004, FR-013, FR-016, and FR-018 for workspace boundaries, secret protection, transcript trust, and prohibited audit side effects.
Reviewed spec.md SC-007 and frozen refinery-state.md D-005 and Q-004; retained the approved evidence-sharing boundary.
FR-006 requires stable issue identifiers and evidence identifying source, session, and occurrence.
FR-012 requires reporting the fixed window, source coverage, skipped or uncertain sessions, read and analysis failures, and backlog result, distinguishing full, partial, and failed runs.
Reviewed spec.md FR-006, FR-012, FR-017, and FR-019 for evidence traceability, run outcomes, future scheduling readiness, and coverage limitations.
Reviewed spec.md Key Entities: Audit run, Session, Evidence occurrence, and Regression.
Reviewed spec.md User Story 3 Acceptance Scenarios 1–3 and SC-005 and SC-006.
User Story 3, Scenario 2 requires actionable, distinguishable outcomes for missing prerequisites or incomplete coverage; FR-017 requires non-interactive repeatability without enabling a schedule.
FR-001 and SC-006 require documented prerequisites and verification of actual manual invocation in a representative environment.
FR-017 prohibits installing or enabling a schedule; the approved design selects a skill plus local helper rather than requiring a separately published standalone binary.

Frozen design.md explicitly delegates executable and skill packaging to planning and requires host-format compatibility to be verified or reported as a limitation. A public release pipeline or broader platform matrix is not an approved-scope requirement.
Reviewed frozen design.md Quality and safety and Builder choices to resolve in planning for actual invocation verification and explicit host compatibility limitations.
Reviewed frozen refinery-state.md D-004, Q-003, and Q-007; retained manual-first operation and separate scheduling authorization.
Reviewed spec.md FR-001 and FR-017, User Story 3, and SC-006 for documented prerequisites and repeatable manual invocation without scheduling.
FR-002 captures one audit-start instant; FR-006 through FR-008 require stable identifiers, one shared backlog, and individually traceable grouped occurrences.
FR-009 and FR-014 protect human-maintained content; FR-015 requires idempotence over identical evidence and identifiable duplicate or split representations.
FR-010 requires evidence linking subsequent recurrence to a completed fix; Edge Cases explicitly prohibits asserting a regression when post-fix timing cannot be established.
Key Entities defines runs, sessions, evidence occurrences, issues, and linked regressions. Identifier mechanisms and the issue-file representation are explicitly delegated to planning.
Reviewed frozen refinery-state.md D-006 through D-008 and corresponding answered questions; retained separate regressions, whole-session coverage, and root-problem grouping.
Reviewed spec.md FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-006, FR-007, FR-008, FR-009, FR-010, FR-014, and FR-015.
Reviewed spec.md Key Entities and User Story 2 for stable issue identity, occurrence grouping, human status preservation, regression links, and safe persistence.
Exact test fixtures are delegated to planning in frozen design.md; ARCH-001 requests behavioral acceptance assertions, not a fixture framework or model choice.

FR-005 requires contextual identification and exclusion of unrelated problems, but SC-002 only constrains "Every reported fixture finding"; no measurable outcome explicitly requires recovering known supported problems and rejecting unrelated controls.
Reviewed frozen design.md Quality and safety for representative end-to-end fixtures, host coverage, deduplication, regression, secret handling, and concurrent-edit testing.
Reviewed spec.md FR-002, FR-003, FR-005, FR-008, FR-009, FR-010, FR-013, FR-014, FR-015, and FR-019 against acceptance scenarios and edge cases.
Reviewed spec.md SC-001 through SC-007 and all three Independent Test descriptions.

SC-001 through SC-007 cover eligibility, finding fields, repeat-run deduplication, regression and concurrent-edit preservation, source limitations, manual invocation, secrets, and transcript instructions.
User Scenarios & Testing and Edge Cases cover whole-session context, ambiguous metadata, interrupted runs, duplicate representations, and incomplete coverage.
